purpose: Audit partner-ranking rules for manual-bet mode using deployed Ability v1, M3 core and P10 models reconstructed from strictly prior TARGET histories.
universe: JRA flat only, field_size>=12, 3-win class or higher; complete 2025-2026 result races available in uploaded TARGET exports
flat_filter_correction: Obstacle OP rows were explicitly excluded in v1.1. Two obstacle races had been inadvertently included in the first v1 audit.
eligible_axis_definition: Exactly one M3 Top3 x Ability Top3 structural horse; axis Ability rank 1 or 2; final-popularity proxy 1-6; Ability1 also P10<50%. Final popularity is used only as a historical proxy for the current market-eligibility gate.

scenario_rescue_shadow_audit.tested_rule_upper_bound: Add at most one non-axis Ability>=4 horse chosen first by M3 rank among the remaining M3 Top3 horses. This broader rule is an upper-bound screen before the proposed main-scenario filter.
scenario_rescue_shadow_audit.interpretation: No production promotion. Wide adds no capture. Quinella/trio gain shrinks materially in 2026 and price/ROI is unvalidated. Runtime main-scenario rescue may be shown as SHADOW only and logged forward.

ui_policy.partner_rank: Order non-axis horses by Ability rank only.
ui_policy.core_partners: Partner ranks 1-2 are CORE for quinella/wide review; rank 3 is BACKUP.
ui_policy.trio_pool: Use Ability partner ranks 1-3 as the primary three-horse opponent pool.
ui_policy.m3_p10_scenario: Display as traits/risk/context, not ranking weights.
ui_policy.scenario_rescue: At most one Ability>=4 x M3 Top3 x current main-scenario Top3 horse may be displayed as SHADOW only. It must not alter partner rank, ticket status, stake, or ROI claims.
ui_policy.market: Display popularity and price downstream only; do not use them to reorder partners.

caveats: This is a retrospective reconstruction using final popularity as a proxy for the axis 1-6 popularity gate because exact T-15 historical snapshots are unavailable.
Partner ordering itself is market-independent and uses strictly prior histories, but price/ROI of Ability-ranked pair choices is not established by this audit.
The exact pre-race main-scenario rescue criterion has not been separately frozen and OOS-validated; it remains SHADOW only.
Forward logging is required before any rescue rule is promoted to a production ticket decision.
